questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file and do not run anything. Release team brief: build MyVest and start a test session on chernarus. The brief gives no dependency list. MyVest is not a bundle. workspace/MyVest/config.cpp declares class CfgPatches { class MyVest_Data { requiredAddons[] = {"DZ_Data", "DZ_Characters_Vests"}; }; }; and workspace/MyVest/scripts/config.cpp declares class CfgPatches { class MyVest_Scripts { requiredAddons[] = {"DZ_Scripts", "MyVest_Data"}; }; };. Do you launch, and with which dependencies? Write the exact /dayz-launch-test command you run, or say why you stop.
questions.verified: agents/dayz-build-engineer.md step 4c (no dependency list and not a bundle: launch with no dependencies and let /dayz-launch-test run the requiredAddons check); skills/dayz-launch-test/launch.py:118-143 (workspace_patches reads every config.cpp, skipping .git, Addons and Keys) and :167-177 (the mod's own patches count as provided); vanilla patches start with DZ_, e.g. P:/DZ/AI/config.cpp:1-11
